limitations: Independent agent review, not human ground truth. The reviewer authored development, not this evaluation split.

Reviewed all 37 proposed entries in full frozen evaluation question, event-prefix, scope and source context. Proposal, corpus and packet-label hash bindings and exact original annotation matches were checked. All proposed passages are contiguous source extracts within 160 characters.

Thirty-six passage forms are approved, including one already accepted legacy sentence; 35 annotation entries gain a new form. One historical-echo passage is rejected only as an extra answer form, not as valid supporting evidence or a correction to corpus gold.
The eval03 shoe source remains absent from its fixed retrieval packet; approving its corpus answer form does not repair retrieval or change the denominator.

No v2 verifier output, model call, scorer change, gold edit, retrieval tuning or prompt change informed these decisions. The supplied proposal explains that the overall v2 recommendation followed a prior v1 control-format failure; this review does not retrospectively pass that control.

Focused-extract acceptability involves judgment. These exact approvals do not license arbitrary surrounding text, substring credit, omission of negation or qualifiers, or relaxed evidence-passage checks. Original pilot and agent-corpus limitations remain.
